posts.content:
Well - as of now we are still not even on level 1.  But very close to us  to our west and south folks are on level 3.  We have been pretty smoke free until today.  The fire has moved far south and west.  It’s basically directly west of us.  We are worried about Thursday- Saturday.  Strong winds from the west - likely pushing the fire right towards us.  

The fire has not been focused for the last couple of days.  I did take a bunch of pics on Sunday.  

We head to Stevenson tomorrow- which is probably good.  I feel like there isn’t anything for us to do here.  We have cameras set up.  

Fingers crossed we don’t go to level 1- but my prediction is we go to 3 on Thursday morning or tomorrow night.  We will see.

posts.content:
Technically we are still not even on level 1.   Lots of folks close to our south and west on level 3.  I added some photos from Sunday.  The fire was less defined for the last couple of days.  We have had very little smoke- that all changed today.  

We are worried about Thursday- Saturday.  The wind forecast seems to be strong west winds.  Now that the fire has moved so far south - it’s basically just west of us.  That’s bad- they don’t seem to have any control over it at all. That’s bad too.  

I have that sick feeling again.
